name_input: Tesla Transformers (India) Ltd; Tesla Transformers India Ltd
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/tesla-transformers-india-limited) — counter states "Total Shipments 156 Records detected", "Trading Partners 9", "Ports 14", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually visible in the free view: 5 shipment rows (3 export, 2 import). Exact export line: "2026-02-28 | TESLA TRANSFORMERS (INDIA) LIMITED | DHAKA POWER DISTRUBUTION COMPANY | Transformers (Copper Wound) above 25000KVA | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India -> Dhaka, Bangladesh | HS 85042310 | BOL 1142613". Other visible export rows: 2026-02-24 -> BENAPOLE, Bangladesh, HS 85042310, BOL 9971515; 2026-02-13 -> Lae, Malaysia (buyer GEOGAS PNG LIMITED), HS 85042310, BOL 9656217; 2026-02-12 -> Lae, Papua New Guinea, HS 85049010 (transformer parts), BOL 9617308. Buyer-side counter confirms repeat buyers: "IDEAL ELECTRICAL ENTERPRISES LTD — 12", "GEOGAS PNG LIMITED — 5", "DHAKA POWER DISTRUBUTION COMPANY — 2".
domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: tofler.in returned 404, zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned 403, eximpedia.app returned 403, volza.com returned 403, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) for all queries. Registered address visible in the ImportKey header: "PLOT NO 23-A, SECTOR-B, INDUSTRIAL AREA, GOVINDPURA" (Bhopal, MP) — address only, not supply evidence. Domestic supply therefore not confirmed and not denied; null.
note: Declared HS 850422 (liquid dielectric transformers <=650 kVA) does not match the actually shipped goods: all visible export rows are HS 85042310 (liquid dielectric transformers >10,000 kVA) plus one parts row 85049010. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground — company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to 850423 (primary) with 85049010 as secondary. Export activity is factually confirmed by customs B/L records with dates, destinations (Bangladesh, Malaysia, Papua New Guinea) and B/L numbers, not by website claims. The company is also an importer (copper winding strips from NANTONG BAIWEI ELECTRIC CO., LTD, HS 74081190, BOL 7619498, 2026-02-19), consistent with a genuine transformer manufacturer rather than a pure trader. Role: manufacturer (production-linked raw-material imports + own-name exports of finished transformers). Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free views — null, not estimated. Caveat: only 5 of the 156 claimed rows were visible without a paid subscription; the 156/9/14 counters are the source's own figures and were not independently verified.
